speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. To begin our assessment of your weakness and fatigue, please describe exactly how these symptoms started and if anything makes them better or worse. Have you noticed any changes in your weight, appetite, or sleep patterns recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. She mentions experiencing these symptoms currently. The patient has been traveling, hiking, and camping recently and notes having had multiple illnesses in the recent past.

speaker: Doctor
text: That sounds exhausting; given your recent travel, hiking, and multiple illnesses, have you noticed any specific triggers like heat exposure, insect bites, or changes in your menstrual cycle? Also, have you experienced fevers, chills, or unusual sweating alongside this weakness?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Weakness and fatigue. I also have Mild diplopia.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis.

The combination of significant weakness/fatigue, worsening with exertion (end of day), and mild diplopia (double vision) in a young woman is highly characteristic of Myasthenia Gravis.

To confirm this, I need to know if you have experienced any difficulty swallowing (dysphagia) or speaking clearly (dysarthria). Additionally, please request the results of an Acetylcholine Receptor Antibody test and a Chest CT scan to check for a thymoma.

REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_Receptor_Antibody
REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_CT
